items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: And in Kansas City, when we were there, we got a young comedian out of the burlesque and that was Red Skelton.

ctx.x: in the band, and we had -- I can't remember who -- oh, yeah, a fellow by the -- I can't think of his name, a good trumpet player. He was out of St. Louis. And Coffee was out of St. Louis.

So I travelled with them, because each state we would maybe stay six months. And we stayed in Denver, we went to Minneapolis, Atlantic City and Kansas City. And in Kansas City, when we were there, we got a young comedian out of the burlesque and that was Red Skelton. That was one of his first jobs, and he stayed with them until -- oh, he stayed with them about two or three years.
Well, did the Walkathons have sort of shows?
